bio: Hello! I'm Vladyslav, a Junior Fullstack Developer. I build modern web applications using React, TypeScript, Node.js, and Express.js. I work with state management using Zustand, integrate external APIs, design and implement backend functionality, and manage databases with Prisma ORM. I also create animations and interactive UI effects with Framer Motion, focusing on performance, user experience, and clean code. My goal is to develop reliable, scalable, and user-friendly web solutions.
